venues.name: Eastern Pearl / former Webster Five bank

source.title: Living in Webster, MA: The Ultimate Local Guide | Homes.com
source.reviewMethod: Root agent enlarged and visually inspected the actual in-browser video frame; appearance observations are not derived from a transcript.

observed: Red brick front of the one-story former bank.
Two dark projecting trapezoid bow windows, with shallow hipped metal-looking caps, flank the centered entrance.
Dark brown central door, narrow sidelights, and five small round-headed transom lights.
Wide white fluted pilasters, entablature, dentils, broken triangular pediment and central urn ornament.
A light stone band near the cornice retains the old savings-bank inscription.
Raised front terrace, central concrete stair and black metal railings; conical evergreens partly obscure the right bay and left frontage.

facts: Deep center entry with trabeated surround and broken pediment
Granite retaining wall and landscaped setback
